intermediate.name: Puerto de Barx
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Puerto de Barx (143.6 km)

story: The stage was overshadowed by a crash with just over 30 km remaining, when race leader Pogačar hit an object on the road and lost control of his bike. He was forced to abandon with injuries to his left arm and shoulder. The race eventually came down to the expected bunch sprint, where -Coquard narrowly beat Pedersen to claim his first-ever Grand Tour stage victory. Enric Mas took over the red jersey.
